harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a fresh three-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster across node1/node2/node3 (AlmaLinux 9, no package available, installed from upstream binary release), opened firewalld ports 2379/2380, and loaded application keys under /app/*. Simulated permanent, unrecoverable loss of the node3 member by stopping etcd and wiping its data directory, then confirmed node1/node2 retained quorum with keys still readable. Removed the dead member (be0a6550ae746ae3) via etcdctl, added a new member for node3 (be6219fd849d98d6) with initial-cluster-state=existing, and started fresh etcd there — it synced automatically and all application keys (db_host, feature_flag, requests) reappeared intact. Final cluster: 3 healthy members, single leader (node1), fully synced raft indices. Then ran the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured boot_id + etcd health baseline on all 3 nodes, restarted each one at a time via `systemctl reboot`, polled until exec was available again, confirmed each node's boot_id changed, and verified full cluster health/quorum/data integrity after each restart before moving to the next node.
actions_performed: Confirmed etcd was not installed on any node; installed etcd v3.5.17 binaries from GitHub releases on node1, node2, node3
Created etcd system user and /var/lib/etcd data dir on each node
Wrote systemd unit files with initial-cluster bootstrap config for node1/node2/node3
Opened firewalld ports 2379/2380 on all three nodes (initial peer connections failed with 'no route to host' until this was done)
Started etcd on all three nodes and verified 3-member healthy cluster formed
Wrote three application keys (/app/config/db_host, /app/config/feature_flag, /app/counters/requests) and verified replication to all members
Captured healthy baseline: endpoint health, member list, endpoint status (raft index 20), and per-node key reads including node3
Simulated permanent loss of node3's member: stopped and disabled etcd, deleted all data under /var/lib/etcd on node3
Verified node1/node2 retained quorum (2/3 healthy) and app keys remained readable while node3 was down
Removed dead member be0a6550ae746ae3 from cluster via etcdctl member remove
Added new member for node3 via etcdctl member add with initial-cluster-state=existing
Updated node3's systemd unit to initial-cluster-state=existing and started etcd fresh; new member be6219fd849d98d6 synced automatically
Verified full 3-member cluster health, correct membership, matching raft indices (28), and all application keys present on rebuilt node3
Captured boot_id and etcd/data health baseline on all three nodes
Restarted node1 via backgrounded systemctl reboot (ack returned before disconnect), polled until exec available, confirmed changed boot_id, verified full cluster health/quorum/data after recovery
Repeated restart+verify sequence for node2, confirming changed boot_id and full cluster recovery before proceeding
Repeated restart+verify sequence for node3 (the replaced member), confirming changed boot_id and final full cluster health, correct 3-member list, and intact application keys at raft index 43
